title: Signed line ordinary constraint data
statement: Let A be a commutative ring sheaf, P an A-module sheaf, and P^[d] its signed powers [def-pur-signed-line-pullback-normalization-data]. OrdinaryLineConstraints(A,P,u,p,e) means: u: (- tensor P^[0]) ≅ Id sends x tensor r to r x; p_n: ((- tensor P^[n+1]) tensor P) ≅ (- tensor P^[n+2]) sends (x tensor y) tensor q to x tensor (y tensor q); and e_n: ((- tensor Hom(P^[n+1],A)) tensor P^[n+1]) → Id sends (x tensor phi) tensor y to phi(y)x. These identities hold on sections over every site object, for every module sheaf and every n≥0.

source.place: Tags 03D2, 03D3, 03EL and 0FNY; for derived localization use derived.tex Tags 06YU, 07A4 and 015F. Specialization of the Powers and duals paragraph of the current blueprint.

proof.text: Define the conjunction of the scalar-unit, reassociation, and evaluation pure-section formulas. The signed negative power is the internal Hom of the corresponding positive power; evaluation is its value at the identity slice object.

proof_origin.place: Powers and duals, including unit, positive tensor recursion, evaluation, and unbounded derived action. The component proof is given below and in the attached Lean module.

def OrdinaryLineConstraints (A : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max u v w})
    (P : KFlatFixedTensor.Modules A)
    (ordinaryUnit : siteSheafTensorRight (signedLinePower.{u, v, w} P 0) ≅ 𝟭 _)
    (ordinaryProduct : ∀ n : ℕ,
      siteSheafTensorRight (signedLinePower.{u, v, w} P (.ofNat (n + 1))) ⋙
        siteSheafTensorRight (signedLinePower.{u, v, w} P 1) ≅
      siteSheafTensorRight (signedLinePower.{u, v, w} P (.ofNat (n + 2))))
    (ordinaryEvaluation : ∀ n : ℕ,
      siteSheafTensorRight (signedLinePower.{u, v, w} P (.negSucc n)) ⋙
        siteSheafTensorRight (signedLinePower.{u, v, w} P (.ofNat (n + 1))) ⟶ 𝟭 _) : Prop
